title: Retain User Permissions During Cloud Migration

facts.text: By default, Business Central removes system-scope permission set assignments except SUPER, assigns INTELLIGENT CLOUD permission set.
LOCAL permission set is retained; INTELLIGENT CLOUD permission set assigned to prevent non-SUPER users from modifying data.
Business Central 14 migration retains user permissions automatically.
Before cloud migration setup, use SUPER account to open Cloud Migration Management, select Actions > Enable/Disable Removing Permissions from Users.
Create per-tenant extension with event subscriber handling OnBeforeResetUsersToIntelligentCloudPermissions to retain permissions.
Changing permission retention setting before setup doesn't restore permissions already removed.
